# The Farmer Companies / Company Spotlight
**Adam:** As you can imagine, I had to sell a lot of Safe2S’its to even make my money back. And after four or five months of making $50 a day, I realized that I wanted to learn about raising money. So I coldcalled Merrill Lynch in Burlington.

...

We think that Whisps has one of the best attributes that’s not marketed to its full extent: How many other snacks can claim they’re made with one ingredient? When you’re partnering with such a well-known brand in this space, you’re already three quarters of the way there.

...

**Blaise** : _How have you approached fundraising? You recently secured $500,000 in funding from VCET._
**Adam** : One cool thing about our raises is I’d say 90 percent of our capital is from Vermont investors. It’s a small community here, and the fact that so many of the local investment groups believe in our mission is very flattering. It’s an honor.

...

We’ve received support from [VCET](https://vcet.co/) , the [Dudley Fund](https://www.dudleyfund.com/) , [FreshTracks](https://www.freshtrackscap.com/) … we’re very happy to have all those folks as partners.

...

**Adam** : We’re actually trying to get away from the private equity label. We’re not a fund, we’re more of an operating business – like a Berkshire Hathaway conglomerate model. People are investing into us as a single entity with multiple subsidiaries. Would I want to move to Boston or New York?

snippets.snippet: July 30, 2026 Facebook Twitter WhatsApp Linkedin The Farmer Companies The Farmer Companies , a Burlington, VT-based provider of a cheese snack platform, raised $17M in Series A financing. The round was led by Raff Ventures with participation from AJAX Capital Partners. The company intends to use the funds to expand its national distribution, making strategic acquisitions, and scaling its manufacturing network across North America. Led by CEO Randy Johnson, The Farmer Companies is a consumer packaged goods (CPG) platform and brand builder specializing in cheese-based snacking and licensed food products.
